highlights.title: A restarted agent says why
highlights.line: On Windows, when a Claude agent stops and Kosmos starts it again, its card says when and why, such as a sign-in or a usage limit.

highlights.title: A failed download gives the system's reason
highlights.line: When the Mac app cannot save a download, its message now adds the system's reason when there is one, such as Permission denied.

highlights.title: A Meta agent out of quota says so
highlights.line: When Meta's usage quota stops a Meta agent, Kosmos now says so in Meta's words, and when it resets, instead of only that it could not run.
